topic: Map functionality and full screen view
summary_markdown: The discussion addressed the technical limitations of map display size. Initially, it was clarified that a specific button is for centering and scaling the map to fit all client sensors, not for increasing the overall map size. Later, [me] noted that clients frequently request a full-screen view for maps within dashboards, which requires follow-up with the frontend developer.
decisions: The current map functionality does not allow for arbitrary enlargement beyond its designated space.
action_items: [me] is writing to the frontend developer regarding implementing a full-screen button for maps in dashboards.
